examples.instruction: Never recreate black rectangular rear lamp boxes. Rear lamps must be smoked red, rounded, segmented, farther outboard and visually integrated into the quarter/hatch.
Never promote a silhouette improvement that erases Abu Dhabi/Total/Citroen identity, glass, dark aero, white roof treatment or yellow accents.
Generated yellow geometry may not appear as hooks or false outlines around the lower projector pods.
